name: What is the typical process for removing a load-bearing wall for a kitchen remodel?
description: The process involves structural assessment, permit acquisition, temporary support installation, wall removal, permanent beam installation, and finishing work.

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for removing a load-bearing wall for a kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process typically begins with a structural engineer's assessment and design for a new support system, such as a steel beam or laminated veneer lumber (LVL). This design is then used to obtain necessary permits. Our team at Hometelligent Inc. prepares the site, installs temporary supports, carefully removes the wall, and then installs the permanent structural beam. After the beam is secured and inspected, we complete the finishing work to integrate the new open space seamlessly into your kitchen design.
